should_trigger: Run the rollback runbook — revert the last deploy.
The ops router selected class=rollback — execute the rollback playbook.
Back out the release and return to the previous known-good version.
Execute the rollback-class operations playbook (interactive, never autonomous).
Roll the deployment back via the approved runbook.
should_not_trigger: Run the incident runbook — production is down with no revert target.
Run the release runbook and cut a release.
Set up monitoring dashboards and alerts.
Run the maintenance runbook for the dependency bump.
Roll back the guild:tdd skill to its previous version.
Compute the release-readiness gate — should we release?
